inlineSql: Select * From LBR_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LBR_CODE = ' ? '
SELECT LBR_CODE As LbrCodeL,LBR_CATG as CategoryL,LBR_VAL As LbrValueR FROM LBR_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY LBR_CATG,LBR_CODE
Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
SELECT A.IT_CODE,A.DM_SIZE As IT_NAME, '' As DesignL FROM DM_SIZE AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.IT_CODE,A.DM_SIZE ORDER BY A.IT_CODE,A.DM_SIZE

SELECT A.IT_CODE,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_DESIGN FROM ITM_WT_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.IT_CODE,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_DESIGN ORDER BY A.IT_CODE,A.IT_DESIGN
SELECT A.IT_CODE,A.DM_SIZE FROM DM_SIZE AS A WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.IT_CODE,A.DM_SIZE ORDER BY A.IT_CODE,A.DM_SIZE
SELECT A.IT_CODE,B.IT_NAME FROM ITM_WT_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.IT_CODE,B.IT_NAME ORDER BY A.IT_CODE
SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME FROM DM_SIZE AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.IT_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY DM_SIZE

SELECT A.*,B.IT_NAME FROM ITM_WT_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.IT_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.IT_DESIGN = 'N' ORDER BY A.SR_NO
